errors.text_span: Всички линии са сплошни и маркирани с кръгли точки, които са обозначени с конкретни числови стойности.
errors.evidence: The lines in the figure are solid but do not have markers (circular points). The atom checklist confirms no markers are present (blue_line_style, orange_line_style, grey_line_style).
The lowest value for the blue line (administrative buildings) is 70 in 2022, not 95 in 2020. The atom checklist (blue_line_2022) confirms 70 as the final value.

The highest value for the orange line (other buildings) is 5,774 in 2018, not 5,562 in 2017. The atom checklist (orange_line_peak) states the peak is 5,460 in 2017, but the figure shows 5,774 in 2018.
The description does not explicitly state that the y-axis has no labels or units, as required by the atom (y_axis_label).
The description omits the detail that the blue line (administrative buildings) is predominantly straight with minor variations, as specified in the atom (blue_line_trend).
The description does not mention the specific trend of the orange line (other buildings) having both rises and falls, as required by the atom (orange_line_trend).
